about: Facts observed on the owner's MPC Live Mk1 (probe v6 report and XMP sessions, 2026-11-11; Akai's MPC OS 3.10.1 over developer-mode SSH, 2026-11-12). No serial numbers, hostnames or addresses. The session emulator is built from this file and tests check the session's constants against it.

board.cpuReport: ARMv7 Processor rev 1 (v7l) x 4, armv7l, 32-bit (MPC OS 3.10.1, 2026-11-12)

display.rotationConfirmed: session 2026-11-11: pad grid upright with rotation 270

touch.mapping: scale x to the framebuffer's 800 columns and y to its 1280 rows, then undo the screen rotation (270); every touch landed on its control (session 2026-11-11)

audio.xmpFormat: 48 kHz stereo S16 through alsa-lib plug onto outputs 1-2; heard by the owner 2026-11-11
audio.measured: session 3 (93 s): 17401 blocks, 0 xruns, peak -12.4 dBFS, audio thread SCHED_FIFO pinned to isolated CPU 3

controller.pads: notes on MIDI channel 10; pad 1 = note 0x25
controller.buttons: notes on MIDI channel 1, on the Private port after start-up (map below, from the owner's session 4, 2026-11-11)
controller.startup: identity request and Akai's start-up sequence sent to the Private port; pads light their squares (2026-11-11)
controller.afterStartup: pads, buttons and knobs arrive on the Private port; the controller replies to the identity request on both ports (the reply carries the unit's serial number, which XMP does not log)

padBank.note: the four pad bank buttons, in the order pressed

map.pads: pad 13 top left; the 4x4 grid reads 13-16, 9-12, 5-8, 1-4 from the top row down (confirmed)

knobs.note: data wheel: 01 one step clockwise, 7F one step anticlockwise

map.rowsOrder: the owner pressed each row in order; left to right is assumed

labels.source: the owner's session-4 codes (2026-11-11) matched, code for code, against the open MPC mapper's published MPC button numbers (references/repos/mpc-livexplore-libs/src/tkgl_midimapper.h, MPC_BT_*, decimal); every code the owner pressed has the label the mapper gives it
labels.6F: data wheel press (from the mapper; not yet pressed in a session)

storage.emmcPartitions: rootfs (ext4, 402.6 MB, mounted / read-only by MPC OS) and mmcblk0p7 (/data, 6.6 GB)

endurance: session 4: 17.7 min, 21317 sequenced notes, 0 late, 0 xruns, peak -12.0 dBFS, audio thread on isolated CPU 3
phase2: session 8 (owner, 2026-11-12): 296 s with eight tracks and the synth; 1505 sequenced notes, 0 late, 25 recorded, 83 touches, 106 buttons, 1783 knob and wheel moves, 0 xruns, audio thread on isolated CPU 3; peak reached the -12.0 dBFS ceiling (the hard limit clipped when voices stacked)

mpcOs.distribution: az0x (inMusic Brands AZ0x base distribution) 5.0.18, Yocto scarthgap, systemd
mpcOs.updaterImage: SNAPSHOT-20261107130239 (MPC (Gen 1) 3.10.1 Updater.app, signed by inMusic team XV2563R65Q)
mpcOs.bootUnchanged: /boot is byte-identical to 3.10.0 (same kernel, device trees and stock boot script); 51 other files differ, all rebuilt Akai programs
mpcOs.app: /usr/bin/MPC, run by acvs.service; about 800 MiB resident when idle, ~5% CPU, the unit 88% idle overall
mpcOs.appAudio: 44.1 kHz, 2 in / 6 out, 128-frame buffer (Akai's app log)
mpcOs.developerMode: OpenSSH 9.6 on port 22, ed25519 host key, root login with no password (anyone on the same network gets root while it is on); the Remote Screen app uses a separate password
mpcOs.plugins: External Plugin Support loads '<drive>/VST2 Plugins/<manufacturer> - VST - <name>/' folders; 32-bit ARM builds (plugin.json file32)

mounts./: /dev/root, Akai's rootfs on the eMMC, ext4 read-only, 402.6 MB, 96% full
mounts./data: /dev/mmcblk0p7 on the eMMC, ext4, 6.6 GB (also /media/az01-internal; overlays for /etc and /var)
mounts./sdcard: /dev/mmcblk1p1, the internal SD card, ext4, 14.4 GB (also /media/az01-internal-sd)
mounts./media: tmpfs; USB sticks appear as /media/<label> on /dev/sd*

mpcOs.network: Wi-Fi through wpa_supplicant and connman; the USB-B port does not show up on the Mac in standalone mode (no network or USB device, 2026-11-12)
